# SolarLight Solutions

> Professional B2B Manufacturer of Industrial Solar Street Lights, LiFePO4 Solar Lighting Systems, and Off-Grid Illumination for Central Asia, the Middle East, and Global Export.

## Organization Overview
- **Legal Entity**: SolarLight Solutions Co., Ltd.
- **Manufacturing Headquarters**: Weifang, Shandong Province, China (Postal Code: 261000)
- **Established**: 2014 (10+ Years of Manufacturing & Export Experience)
- **Facility Credentials**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified Production Facility
- **Primary Export Regions**: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Azerbaijan, CIS & Global Markets
- **Official Website**: https://solarlight.kz

## Core Product Series & Specifications
- **Falcon Series (All-In-One Integrated Solar Street Light)**:
  - Power: 30W – 150W | Luminous Flux: 4,800 lm – 24,000 lm (160 lm/W high-efficacy Philips Lumileds LED)
  - Solar Panel: High-efficiency Monocrystalline Silicon (21.5% conversion efficiency)
  - Energy Storage: Grade-A LiFePO4 Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery (3.2V / 12.8V, 2000+ deep cycles)
  - Controller: Intelligent MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) with microwave radar motion sensor
  - Protection: IP66 Waterproof, IK10 Impact Resistance, Operating Temperature: -30°C to +60°C
  - Recommended Applications: City avenues, highways, industrial parks, municipal roadways.

- **Leaf Series (Split-Type High-Output Solar Lighting)**:
  - Power: 60W – 150W | Luminous Flux: 9,600 lm – 24,000 lm
  - Solar Panel: Independent Adjustable Monocrystalline Panel (100Wp – 300Wp)
  - Features: Heavy-duty cold-climate battery box with thermal insulation for sub-zero steppe winters.
  - Recommended Applications: Intercity highways, mountain passes, airport perimeters, mining sites.

- **ALCA Series (Modular Solar Street Light)**:
  - Power: 40W – 100W | Luminous Flux: 6,400 lm – 16,000 lm
  - Features: Die-cast aluminum alloy housing, aerodynamic wind-resistant profile, tool-free maintenance.
  - Recommended Applications: Residential developments, commercial boulevards, university campuses.

- **Kmini & Nova Series (Compact Community & Village Lighting)**:
  - Power: 20W – 60W | Luminous Flux: 3,200 lm – 9,600 lm
  - Features: Plug-and-play installation, zero electrical cabling required, integrated twilight-to-dawn sensor.
  - Recommended Applications: Rural village electrification, parking areas, public parks, perimeter security.

## Engineering & Climate Adaptation
- **Central Asian Steppe & Winter Conditions (-30°C to +40°C)**:
  - Cold-resistant LiFePO4 battery chemistry with intelligent low-temperature charge protection.
  - Optimized solar tilt angle (35°–45°) for maximum winter insolation and automatic snow shedding.
  - 3–4 days continuous cloudy/snowy day autonomy.
- **Middle Eastern Desert & Arid Conditions (-10°C to +60°C)**:
  - Multi-fin die-cast aluminum heat sink design ensuring LED junction temperature remains <65°C.
  - IP66 hermetically sealed optical chamber preventing dust and sand ingress.
  - Anti-UV and anti-corrosion electrostatic powder coating for high-salinity and desert environments.

## Certifications & Quality Compliance
- **CE Certification**: EN 55015, EN 61547, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 60598-1, EN 60598-2-3
- **RoHS Compliance**: 2011/65/EU and amendment (EU) 2015/863
- **Quality System**: ISO 9001:2015
- **Ingress & Impact Protection**: IP66 (IEC 60529), IK10 (IEC 62262)
- **Warranty**: 5-Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty
